title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The AI Office has issued a formal decision outlining its stance on the use, development, and regulation of artificial intelligence. This decision provides guidelines for responsible AI deployment and sets standards for compliance within the organization.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: This policy explains that the AI Office is hiring technology specialists in AI. It outlines the roles, required skills, and how to apply for these positions.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: This policy announces a vacancy for a Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI office, outlining the role’s responsibilities and required qualifications. Candidates are encouraged to apply through the specified process and bring expertise in AI research, policy, and strategic guidance.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: This policy explains how the organization will fill and manage legal officer positions that focus on AI matters. It sets out the qualifications, responsibilities, and compliance requirements for these legal officers to help guide the company's AI strategy.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: The document explains how to fill the vacancy for AI policy officers, detailing the duties they will perform, the qualifications needed, and the steps for hiring them. It also highlights how these officers will help shape AI policy, guide compliance, and support the organization’s AI strategy.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group of experts tasked with evaluating and providing recommendations on the regulatory framework for artificial intelligence in the European Union. They analyze risks, propose safeguards, and help shape policies to ensure AI is used safely and responsibly.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: The policy document proposes a draft request to standardize AI-related practices, terminology, or processes across the industry. It seeks cooperation from stakeholders to develop shared guidelines, best‑practice frameworks, and compliance measures.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: The CoP Consultation Notice announces a call for stakeholder input on a Community of Practice initiative. It invites relevant parties to review the proposal and provide feedback before finalizing the plan.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: This policy document invites individuals and organizations to express interest in joining or forming a community of practice focused on AI. It explains how to submit an expression of interest and highlights the potential benefits of participation.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: This policy document provides a visual overview of the iterative drafting process used in the Community of Practice. It shows how ideas are repeatedly reviewed, refined, and enhanced through collaborative feedback loops.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: This document shows a visual timeline that maps out each phase of the policy drafting process, from initial concept to final approval. It highlights key milestones and decision points, helping stakeholders understand the sequence and duration of the development stages.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: This document outlines an initial set of guidelines and standards for the responsible development, deployment, and use of artificial intelligence systems, aiming to promote safety, transparency, fairness, and accountability. It serves as a framework for organizations to follow best practices in AI, detailing principles, recommended procedures, and compliance expectations in its first draft.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: The second draft of the Code of Practice provides a set of guidelines for responsible AI use, covering issues such as transparency, fairness, and accountability. It is intended to help developers, users, and regulators ensure AI systems are safe, ethical, and aligned with societal values.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: The Code of Practice: 3rd Draft provides updated guidelines for responsible AI development and deployment, emphasizing transparency, accountability, and safety. It outlines best practices and compliance requirements for organizations to ensure AI systems align with ethical standards.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft outlines a proposed framework for collaboration on artificial intelligence governance. It aims to set shared standards, promote transparency, and ensure responsible AI practices across participating organizations.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is an agreement that sets out principles and guidelines for the responsible development and deployment of artificial intelligence. It stresses safety, fairness, transparency, and international cooperation to prevent misuse and to ensure AI benefits society.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: This document lists AI practices that are not allowed, such as using AI to spread misinformation, create harmful content, or violate privacy and security. It explains why each type of activity is disallowed and the potential consequences for failing to follow the rules.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: This policy provides guidelines for defining what constitutes an AI system, outlining key characteristics and criteria. It helps organizations identify and classify AI technologies to ensure proper oversight and compliance.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: The policy encourages open communication strategies to help startups grow by providing resources, mentorship, and networking opportunities. It also promotes innovation through collaborations, funding support, and public awareness campaigns that highlight emerging tech and entrepreneurial success stories.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start‑Ups is a European program that provides high‑performance computing resources and support to new and early‑stage companies. It aims to help start‑ups accelerate innovation, boost competitiveness, and bring advanced technology solutions to market more quickly.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This slideshow presents a webinar focused on risk management, outlining key concepts and strategies for identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks in projects or organizations. It covers best practices, frameworks, and case studies to help participants develop effective risk management plans.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This policy document outlines a webinar that discusses risk management strategies for AI systems. It covers identifying, assessing, and mitigating potential risks, as well as compliance and best‑practice guidelines.
